name: DoorDash

Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Heavy — new grads start with a HackerRank OA (2 medium–hard problems), then a decentralized team-run loop
rounds: Recruiter screen (~30 min: background, motivation, leveling)
Technical screen / OA: timed, HackerRank or CoderPad, medium–hard problems

Onsite (4–5 rounds, ~1 week turnaround): 2–3 coding rounds, often including a "CodeCraft" round (build a small working logistics-flavored service, e.g. a Dasher-pay calculator or order-assignment component), sometimes a dedicated debugging round
System design (marketplace-scale distributed systems, e.g. coordinating merchants/dashers/consumers under latency constraints)
extraTopics: CodeCraft: building a small working service rather than solving an abstract algorithm problem
Marketplace-scale systems thinking — merchants, dashers and consumers coordinated under real-time constraints
DoorDash has been piloting AI-assisted coding-tool rounds in some loops as of 2026 — worth confirming the current format with your recruiter
